component.name: AI Wars
component.description: Offline trading strategy game for M5Stack CardputerZero (ARM64 Linux).

properties.name: ai-wars:sbom:scope
properties.value: Source repository inventory for the default CardputerZero Release build and Debian package installation using cp0-cross-package. Covers required build inputs, compiled-in libraries, device package dependencies, and installed fonts and audio.

properties.name: ai-wars:sbom:version-basis
properties.value: Versions come from source pins, vendored files, or the default v0.0.4 BSP used by cp0-cross. BSP observations are upstream versions. Device packages resolve at install time and can differ by OS image.

properties.name: ai-wars:sbom:completeness
properties.value: The transitive closure of the installed device packages depends on the device image.

components.name: LVGL
components.description: UI library fetched by CMake at tag v9.5.0 and built into the game.

components.name: Nayuki QR Code generator
components.description: C implementation bundled by LVGL under src/libs/qrcode and enabled by LV_USE_QRCODE.

components.name: TJpgDec
components.description: ChaN's tiny JPEG decoder bundled by LVGL and enabled by LV_USE_TJPGD.

components.name: TLSF
components.description: LVGL adaptation of Matthew Conte's allocator used by the built-in memory backend.

components.name: mpaland/printf
components.description: Formatting implementation bundled in LVGL's built-in sprintf backend.

components.name: Montserrat bitmap glyphs
components.description: Montserrat glyphs compiled into LVGL's enabled built-in fonts.

components.name: Font Awesome 5 bitmap glyphs
components.description: Icon font glyphs compiled into LVGL's enabled built-in fonts.

components.name: miniaudio
components.description: Audio decoding and playback library fetched by CMake and statically linked.

components.name: dr_mp3
components.description: Embedded MP3 decoder in miniaudio, used for the intro music.

components.name: dr_wav
components.description: WAV codec compiled into the game through miniaudio's default codec configuration.

components.name: dr_flac
components.description: FLAC decoder compiled into the game through miniaudio's default codec configuration.

components.name: nlohmann/json
components.description: Vendored header-only JSON library used for configuration and save data.

properties.name: ai-wars:hash-basis
properties.value: Git blob with LF line endings.

components.name: Hedley
components.description: Compiler portability macros included in the vendored JSON header.

components.name: fmt
components.description: Logging and formatting library. The default BSP lacks fmt headers, so CMake fetches the pinned source and links it into the game.

properties.name: ai-wars:license-note
properties.value: Upstream MIT terms include an optional exception for portions embedded in compiled object code.

components.name: CardputerZero BSP sysroot
components.description: Default build-time SDK archive supplying ARM64 target headers and libraries.

components.name: FreeType
components.description: Font rasterizer supplied by the BSP for compilation and by libfreetype6 on the device.

components.name: libpng
components.description: Private, statically linked PNG decoder for CardputerZero.

components.name: System libpng
components.description: Shared PNG library used by the device's FreeType package. The version depends on the OS image.

components.name: libjpeg-turbo
components.description: The default BSP's libjpeg provider, required at configure time. The CardputerZero JPEG decoder enabled in LVGL is TJpgDec.

components.name: zlib
components.description: Compression library supplied by the BSP and required by libpng and FreeType.

components.name: bzip2
components.description: The BSP's FreeType build uses libbz2.

components.name: Brotli
components.description: The BSP's FreeType build uses libbrotlidec and its shared libbrotlicommon library.

components.name: GNU C Library
components.description: C runtime, dynamic loader, math, pthreads and dynamic loading interfaces. The BSP provides glibc 2.41. The Debian package declares libc6 (>= 2.38).

components.name: libstdc++
components.description: GNU C++ standard library. The Debian package declares libstdc++6 (>= 12).

components.name: libgcc
components.description: GNU compiler support runtime supplied by the device's libgcc-s1 package.

components.name: alsa-lib
components.description: Linux audio playback library loaded dynamically by miniaudio. The package accepts libasound2t64 or libasound2.

components.name: tzdata
components.description: Device time zone database used to determine local arrival times.

components.name: intro.mp3
components.description: Bundled introduction music. Created by randombits0110.
